messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert P123456 triggered for prod-inference (hosted-inference-01). Escalation policy 'prod-critical' fired. Primary on-call: Erin. Please ack or auto-escalation in 5m. Details: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/P123456
Erin: Acked. I'm on call. Pulling logs and metrics now.
Erin: Quick glance — nginx upstream 504s, worker queue depth spiking, some model host CPU pegged. Beginning triage.
Josh: On standby. If we need to route traffic, I can flip the routing rule to dedicated pool.
Erin: Plan: 1) try a controlled routing fallback for heavy keys -> dedicated-pool-1 2) scale dedicated pool + warm-up 3) rate-limit noisy API keys if needed.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: Primary did not ack in time window, paging secondary Maria now.
Maria: Acked. Joining thread. Any heads-up on which customers?
Erin: Top offenders look like acme-inc and beta-co. Error rate increase ~0.5% overall, but those two show repeated retries.
Erin: Running scale command and applying routing pref.
Erin: ```
# infra CLI
infra scale --pool dedicated-pool-1 --add 3
admin api route update --service hosted-inference --set-prefer=dedicated-pool-1
```
Josh: I applied the route preference (rolled to 10% traffic -> 50% if stable). Provisioning nodes started, ETA ~2m.
Maria: I'm throttling a few high-volume API keys via the rate-limiter:
Maria: ```
curl -X POST https://console.redwood.internal/rate-limits \
  -d '{"key":"acme-inc","limit":10}' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer TOKEN'
```
Dave: Pinging — manager alert fired due to escalation step. What's customer impact and ETA to mitigation?
Erin: Acked the manager page — impact: ~4% of requests seeing 5-12s latency spikes; 503s up to ~0.6% concentrated on 3 tenants. No full region outages. ETA for noticeable improvement: ~3-5 minutes after nodes finish warming.
SRE-Bridge-Bot: Created bridge call (https://meet.redwood/bridge/P123456) — Dave joining.
Josh: Metrics show CPU on the affected model hosts drop from 98% -> 68% after traffic shift. Request latency p50 unchanged, p95 dropping from 7.8s -> 1.9s.
Maria: Reroute handled ~22% of the heavy traffic; rate-limits prevented cascading retries. Logs show fewer 504s.
Erin: Paused adaptive prefetch/autoscaling tweaks that seemed to amplify bursts (temp change: feature flag off).
Erin: Marking incident as mitigated for live traffic. Will keep monitoring for 15m.
Dave: Thanks team. Please file a post-incident ticket with timeline, affected customers, mitigation steps and follow-ups.
Maria: Creating incident tracker INT-2026-321 and assigning to eng-runtime (root cause & follow-ups).
Erin: Follow-up items I already noted: 1) investigate autoscaling policy flapping 2) verify KV-cache warm-up logic 3) add targeted alert for tenant-level retry storms 4) run a tabletop with SRE.
incident-bot: PagerDuty P123456 acknowledged by Erin, status: acknowledged -> mitigated (monitoring). If no regressions, incident will be marked resolved. :white_check_mark:
Erin: I'll draft a short customer-facing summary and ping support to notify affected tenants. Good job everyone. :thumbsup:
